description: This file defines the BidiExecutionContext class which manages execution contexts for bidirectional protocol interactions in a browser automation framework, including evaluating scripts, handling DOM elements, and managing remote objects.

classes.name: BidiExecutionContext
classes.description: Manages execution contexts for bidirectional protocol, enabling script evaluation, property retrieval, and DOM interaction within a browser automation environment.

methods.name: rawEvaluateJSON
methods.description: Evaluates a script expression in the remote context and returns the result deserialized into a JavaScript value.

methods.name: rawEvaluateHandle
methods.description: Evaluates a script expression and returns a handle to the result object.

methods.name: evaluateWithArguments
methods.description: Calls a function in the remote context with provided arguments and returns the result.

methods.name: getProperties
methods.description: Retrieves enumerable properties of a remote object as a map of handles.

methods.name: releaseHandle
methods.description: Disowns a handle in the remote context to free resources.

methods.name: nodeIdForElementHandle
methods.description: Gets a shared node ID for a DOM element handle.

methods.name: remoteObjectForNodeId
methods.description: Retrieves a JSHandle for a remote object identified by a node ID.

methods.name: contentFrameIdForFrame
methods.description: Gets the frame ID for a content frame from an element handle.

methods.name: frameIdForWindowHandle
methods.description: Gets the frame ID for a window handle.

methods.name: _remoteValueForReference
methods.description: Internal method to get remote value for a reference.

methods.name: _rawCallFunction
methods.description: Internal method to call a function in the remote context.
